# Troubleshooting {#sec-trouble}

## VM hangs at "Booting from Hard Disk"

Set `rombar=0` (uncheck **ROM-Bar**). Disable the slot Option ROM in system BIOS. Some LSI utilities also have "boot from this controller" — turn that off. The VM should boot the virtual OS disk only.

## IOMMU groups missing / "PCI device not available"

VT-d or AMD-Vi is still off, or the kernel flags did not apply.

```bash
cat /proc/cmdline
dmesg | grep -e DMAR -e IOMMU -e AMD-Vi
```

Revisit @sec-bios and @sec-iommu.

## Proxmox still lists the data disks

vfio bind failed. `lspci -k -s 02:00.0` should show `vfio-pci`. Rebuild initramfs after blacklist changes (@sec-vfio).

## TrueNAS sees the HBA but no disks

- Confirm IT firmware, not IR
- Pass **all functions** of the card
- Reseat SFF-8087 / 8643 cables; the card can enumerate with no SAS link
- Check disk power

## Host dies when the VM autostarts

The HBA shared an IOMMU group with the management NIC. From the boot menu, drop `intel_iommu=on` / `amd_iommu=on` for one boot, turn VM autostart off, fix grouping (@sec-identify), then re-enable IOMMU.

## Need ACS override?

Only after a slot change and a BIOS update still leave a dirty group. Homelab only.

## Quick verification set

```bash
cat /proc/cmdline
dmesg | grep -e DMAR -e IOMMU -e vfio
lspci -k -s 02:00.0
ls /sys/kernel/iommu_groups
```
